name: Do I need a permit to build a pergola in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to build a pergola in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many areas of Las Vegas and surrounding communities like Henderson or Summerlin, a building permit may be required for pergola installations, especially if the structure is attached to your home, exceeds a certain size, or includes electrical components. Permit requirements are in place to ensure structures meet local building codes and safety standards. Simply Construction can assist in determining if a permit is needed for your specific project and guide you through the application process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A building permit may be required for pergola installation in Las Vegas, especially for attached or larger structures. Simply Construction can help determine if a permit is needed.
